entities.name: marcus
entities.summary: Marcus is a trainer providing 12-week training blocks starting April 14th and ending July 7th. Sessions occur twice weekly at $80 each, including a nutrition check-in. The user's Tuesday session was moved to 6:30 AM, while Thursdays remain at 7 AM. Marcus's coaching style is calm and educational, emphasizing the reasoning behind exercises. He requires at least two weeks' notice before the block ends for any changes. The user's deadlift max increased from 225 to 275 pounds during the block, and Marcus's schedule adjustments reflect growing client demand.

User must decide by June 23rd whether to extend their training with Marcus, who requires two weeks' notice before the 12-week block ends on July 7th. Marcus mentioned the possibility of reducing the training rate to $70 per session for a 24-week commitment, which would save $480 compared to two 12-week blocks at $80 per session. User confirmed with Marcus that the current rate remains $80 per session since the 24-week extension has not been signed yet. User values the nutrition check-in component included in Marcus's training sessions and wants to ensure it remains part of any future rate structure. User prefers Marcus over Devon and is willing to pay a premium for his training style and the inclusion of nutrition check-ins.
